A consumer of the shape `mov rax, [rip -> 02CA8A80]` / `test rax, rax` / `movzx eax, byte ptr [rax+0xfc]` reported ZERO displacements while dereferencing the object on the next line. Caught by disbelieving a zero: GlyphRunWidget1498 has 5,032 gap bytes and the census said 8 loads / 0 displacements, so I hand-read all ten sites that touch the slot and the second was `mov rcx, [rbx+0xc0]`; the type has 24 displacements.
